sources.title: Fastino Nemotron 3.5 Lightning Finance - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Fastino-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-Finance is a 30B-parameter, 3B-active mixture-of-experts model specialized for financial reasoning, extraction, and research fine-tuned on LoRA with the Fastino Fine-Tuning Agent.

sources.title: Fastino Labs Releases Two Specialized Open-Weight Models for Finance ...
sources.snippet: Fastino Labs, the applied AI research lab and creator of the GLiNER model family, today announced specialised open weight models for finance and healthcare post-trained on NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 ...

sources.title: Introducing Fastino-Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-Finance and Fastino-Nemotron ...
sources.snippet: Fastino released two specialized open-weight models fine-tuned on NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for finance and healthcare tasks, available on Hugging Face.

sources.title: Fastino Labs
sources.snippet: Fastino Labs builds open language models for agentic AI, including GLiNER, GLiGuard, and the Fastino fine-tuning agent. See our research and models.

sources.title: Fastino and NVIDIA: Open Models for Finance and Healthcare
sources.snippet: Fastino Labs collaborates with NVIDIA to post-train open weight Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for finance and healthcare, fine-tuned entirely by an autonomous agent.
